en.sayed-ali-raza: I stand witness that there is no god but Allāh,
He is One and there is no partner with Him. He is the First, such that nothing was before Him. He is the Last, such that there is not limit for Him.
Imagination cannot catch any of His qualities. Hearts cannot entertain belief about His nature.
Analysis and division cannot be applied to Him. Eyes and hearts cannot encompass Him.
